steps.description:
Programs are often split into smaller tasks, each written as a function. Functions make code easier to read, reuse, and organize, especially when the same instructions are needed again and again.

To create a function, use the Function block.

  

A function does not run until it is called. When a function is created, a block with the function name will appear. Use it to call (run) the function.

  

You can call a function multiple times.
